title: Equivalent concrete masonry thickness.
officialText:
For structural steel columns protected with concrete
masonry, Table 721.5.1(5) gives the equivalent thickness of concrete masonry required for various fire-
resistance ratings for typical column shapes. For structural steel columns protected with clay masonry, Table
721.5.1(6) gives the equivalent thickness of concrete masonry required for various fire-resistance ratings for
typical column shapes.
